讨论货币起源并习惯批评“经济理论”把货币同直接交换联系起来的人类学家、社会学家及其他社会科学家，常忽略这一点。格雷伯就以颇为尖刻的方式批评了斯密：他假设有一个“原始”社会，又设想了一种物物交换状态，认为货币是从中产生的（Graeber 2011, ch. 2）。斯密关于“原始人”物物交换的想象当然是错误的，也是那个时代的产物。然而，即使略显粗糙，对物物交换进行抽象也远非斯密分析的主要问题，尤其考虑到这一抽象使他出色地抓住了直接交换的经济困难。问题在于，这一抽象无法在逻辑上说明货币何以从直接交换的困难中产生。当今的“经济理论”充分认识到这个弱点，并尝试通过发展多种进一步的抽象来回答它，正文下文有简述。格雷伯和人类学及相关学科的其他批评者，似乎没有意识到现代货币理论的这一方面。

This point is often missed by anthropologists, sociologists and other social scientists who discuss the origin of money and typically criticise ‘economic theory’ for relating money to direct exchange. Thus, Graeber makes a typically withering attack on Smith for assuming a ‘primitive’ society and an imaginary state of barter out of which money presumably emerges (Graeber 2011, ch. 2). There is, of course, little doubt that Smith’s image of barter among ‘primitives’ is fallacious and a product of its time. However, engaging in the abstraction of barter, even if crudely, is hardly the main problem with Smith’s analysis, particularly as this abstraction allowed him to capture the economic difficulties of direct exchange in exemplary fashion. Rather, the problem is that Smith’s abstraction does not provide a logical foundation for the emergence of money out of the difficulties of direct exchange. Contemporary ‘economic theory’ is fully aware of this weakness and has attempted to answer it by developing a variety of further abstractions, briefly mentioned in the text below. Graeber, and other critics from anthropology and related disciplines, appear unaware of this aspect of modern monetary theory.

能够分析金融化资本主义的理论框架，必然要以本书各章讨论的理论争论和金融化的经验特征为基础。
不过，要使这一框架具有鲜明的马克思主义特征，首先必须厘清近几十年金融兴起的货币基础。在马克思主义政治经济学看来，货币是资本主义经济不可分割的一部分，为金融提供现实基础和理论基础。用辩证法的术语来说，货币是起始范畴，信用与金融则由货币（和资本）范畴的进一步展开而来。马克思主义的信用与金融理论本质上是货币性的，因为它在分析上以货币理论为基础。

A theoretical framework capable of analysing financialised capitalism would necessarily draw on the theoretical debates as well as the empirical features of financialisation, which are discussed in separate chapters of this book.

If the framework is to have a distinctly Marxist character, however, the first step must be to establish the monetary underpinnings of the rise of finance in recent decades. For Marxist political economy, money is an integral part of capitalist economies providing both real and theoretical foundations for finance. In dialectical terms, money is the initial category, while credit and finance derive from the further unfolding of the category of money (and capital). Marxist theory of credit and finance is inherently monetary in the sense that it rests analytically on the theory of money.
金融化资本主义的兴起有赖于特定的货币形式和货币实践。概括地说，金融化资本主义有三个显著的货币特征，本章将进一步考察。

The rise of financialised capitalism has depended on particular forms of money and monetary practices. Summarily put, there are three salient monetary features to financialised capitalism, which are further examined in this chapter.
第一，商品货币退出了国内货币交易，包括银行业务，这决定了金融化的货币格局。自20世纪70年代初以来，实际上在20世纪的大部分时间里，商品货币（黄金）一直由中央银行作为最后的贮藏手段持有，实际发挥的货币作用微乎其微。
随着商品货币退出货币流通，信用货币完全支配了货币领域。信用货币通常由私人金融机构（银行）创造，由以各种私人和公共金融资产为支撑的私人支付承诺构成。在发达资本主义中，信用体系的相应发展维系着信用货币的主导地位。尽管信用货币占主导，货币形式在金融化过程中仍继续演变，产生了质上有别于信用货币的电子货币。

First, the monetary terrain of financialisation has been determined by the absence of commodity money from domestic monetary transactions, including from the operations of banking. Since the early 1970s – indeed for most of the twentieth century – commodity money (gold) has been a hoard of last resort held by central banks with minimal monetary functioning in practice.

The retreat of commodity money from monetary circulation has been accompanied by the complete domination of the monetary sphere by credit money. This is money that is normally generated by private financial institutions (banks) and comprises private promises to pay backed by a variety of financial assets, both private and public. It is the dominant form of money in advanced capitalism sustained by the corresponding development of the credit system. Nevertheless, despite the dominance of credit money, the form of money has continued to evolve in the course of financialisation, leading to the emergence of electronic money which differs qualitatively from credit money.
第二，私人信用货币取得主导地位的关键，是它依法可以兑换成由中央银行创造、得到国家支持的货币。后者是一种混合形态的货币。它部分属于信用货币，因为它通过信用机制创造（主要是中央银行向私人银行放贷）。它又部分属于法定货币，因为它是不可兑现的法定清偿手段，通常以国家的支付承诺为基础。这种混合形态的货币是国家在金融领域行使权力的最终手段，因为它使国家能够在关键时刻提供流动性并进行支付。

Second, crucial to the ascendancy of private credit money has been its legal convertibility into state-backed money created by central banks. The latter is a hybrid form of money: it is partly credit, since it is created through credit mechanisms (mostly lending by the central bank to private banks); it is partly fiat, since it is inconvertible legal tender that normally rests on the state’s promises to pay. This hybrid form of money is the ultimate lever of state power in the realm of finance because it allows the state to provide liquidity and to make payments at critical junctures.
金融化的一个鲜明特征，是国家借助各种机制有意识地管理国家支持的中央银行货币。中央银行已经成为经济中居于首位的公共机构，通常以独立性为表象。国家对中央银行货币的控制，使其能在整个金融化时期持续干预金融领域。2000年代的全球危机凸显了控制国家支持的信用货币的重要性。

Financialisation has been stamped by the conscious management of state-backed central bank money through various mechanisms of the state. Central banks have emerged as the leading public institution in the economy, typically under the façade of independence. The command exercised by states over central bank money has made sustained intervention in the field of finance possible throughout the period of financialisation. The importance of control over state-backed credit money was demonstrated in the course of the global crisis of the 2000s.

第三，对金融化更重要的是，货币在世界市场中的形式和职能发生了演变。1971—1973年间，原先通过规定美元可按固定比率兑换黄金以稳定汇率的《布雷顿森林协定》瓦解，此后黄金在国际支付中所起的作用微乎其微。从那时起，商品货币一直是国际上的最后贮藏手段，而国际支付手段和贮藏手段的职能在很大程度上由美元接管。过去四十年中，美元发挥准世界货币的作用，对金融化在全球蔓延至关重要。然而，美元的世界性作用也充满矛盾，并会破坏稳定。这尤其体现在它塑造了价值的国际转移，推动资本从穷国流向富国。美元储备的积累推动了发展中国家的金融化，也促成了2000年代的大危机。

Third, and even more important for financialisation, has been the evolution of the form and the functioning of money in the world market. Gold has played a very minor role in international payments following the collapse in 1971–3 of the Bretton Woods Agreement which had stabilised exchange rates by fixing the convertibility of the us dollar into gold. Since then, commodity money has functioned as an international hoard of last resort, while the functions of international means of payment and means of hoarding have been taken over largely by the us dollar. The functioning of the dollar as quasi-world-money during the last four decades has been a development of paramount importance for the global spread of financialisation. However, the world role of the dollar has also been contradictory and destabilising, not least by shaping the international transfers of value and leading to flows of capital from poor to rich countries. The accumulation of dollar reserves has contributed to financialisation in developing countries as well as to the gigantic crisis of the 2000s.

为了使论述完整，还应提到货币在金融化资本主义的社会面貌上留下了印记。共同体与结社纽带弱化，公共供给普遍退缩，货币重新强化了作为一整套社会交往枢纽的地位。金融化资本主义个人的道德与伦理发展，也反映了货币影响的增强。毕竟，金融化的一个内在特征，就是货币关系扩展到医疗、教育、交通和住房等以往较少受货币机制影响的领域。个人收入的金融化，使货币深深渗透到金融化资本主义下家庭的经济生活、社会生活、道德观念和日常习惯之中。

It should also be mentioned, even if only for completeness, that money has placed its mark on the social outlook of financialised capitalism. Communal and associative bonds have shrunk; public provision has generally retreated and money has been re-strengthened as the pivot of a broad range of social interactions. The moral and ethical development of individuals in financialised capitalism has reflected the enhanced presence of money. After all, an integral feature of financialisation has been the spreading of monetary relations in areas that were previously relatively aloof from monetary mechanisms, including health, education, transport and housing. The financialisation of individual income has enabled money to penetrate deeply into the economic, social, moral, and customary life of households in financialised capitalism.
然而，在金融化的几十年间，货币对社会的支配并非无可阻挡地增强。在社会生活的若干领域，人们常常自觉地以集体行动抵制货币地位的上升。地方交换交易系统以及“绿色货币”和“时间货币”等结社交换形式，建立起不经由通常的商业货币组织起来的交换网络。
此外，整个经济中的技术、制度和组织变化，也限制了货币在若干社会交往领域中的作用。例如，与互联网相关的服务和其他商品，包括报纸和音乐，部分摆脱了货币的支配，有时到消费环节已近乎免费。个人生活的某些领域逐渐摆脱货币支配，这一趋势对电子货币产生了重要影响，下文将简要讨论。

By no means, however, has the hold of money over society been inexorably strengthened in the decades of financialisation. Often the ascendancy of money has been consciously opposed through collective action in several areas of social life. Associative forms of exchange, such as Local Exchange Trading Systems, or ‘green’ and ‘time’ money, have created networks functioning without the organising presence of ordinary, commercial money.

Furthermore, technological, institutional and organisational changes across the economy have also restricted the role of money in several areas of social interaction. Services and other goods associated with the internet, for instance, have been partially detached from the power of money, at times becoming nearly free at the point of consumption, including newspapers and music. The trend of distancing some areas of individual life from the power of money has had important implications for electronic money, briefly considered below.
总而言之，金融化的货币基础由过去四十年间货币领域的制度与历史变迁塑造。要充分理解这些变化的意义，就应从根本问题入手：货币是什么，它在资本主义经济和社会中如何发挥作用？下一节简要回到这些基本原理，聚焦马克思主义货币理论，并回顾马克思本人的货币研究。

In sum, the monetary underpinnings of financialisation have been determined by institutional and historical changes occurring in the monetary sphere during the last four decades. To grasp the full significance of these changes, analysis should start from the fundamental questions of what money is and how it functions in capitalist economy and society. The following section undertakes a brief sojourn into first principles, focusing on Marxist monetary theory and recapping Marx’s own work on money.

zh: 2 马克思主义货币理论与当代货币
en: 2 Marxist Monetary Theory in Relation to Contemporary Money

zh: 2.1 马克思货币论著的意义

children: The Significance of Marx’s Monetary Writings
马克思关于货币的著述极为广泛，既有早年关于货币的哲学和文化层面的讨论，也有成熟时期对工业资本主义货币现象的分析，还有报刊文章和通信中对货币事件的随笔式评论。马克思认为货币理论在自己的学术成果中分量很重，主流经济学对此却有不同看法。
更矛盾的是，货币理论在马克思主义经济学中也始终相对欠发展。

Marx’s monetary writings are very extensive, ranging from early discussions of philosophical and cultural aspects of money, to mature analysis of monetary phenomena of industrial capitalism, to asides on monetary events in newspaper articles and correspondence. Marx considered monetary theory to be a weighty part of his intellectual output but this is not how the matter is perceived by mainstream economics.
Even more paradoxically, monetary theory has remained a relatively underdeveloped part of Marxist economics.
主流经济理论通常承认马克思是伟大的思想家，却全盘否定他的货币理论，甚至并不了解这套理论。有人毫无根据地把马克思视为一个与当代货币现象关系甚微的“金属主义者”。这种观点的盛行在很大程度上归因于熊彼特。他对经济思想史所作的笼统断言，很容易让不熟悉原始文本的人陷入误解。
这也与马克思确实大量提到黄金有关，马克思主义和非主流经济学家常受其误导。
一些马克思主义货币理论家仍试图在当代货币现象中为黄金寻找某种积极作用，尤其着眼于货币作为价值尺度的职能。
他们预设，若不能证明货币仍具有商品形式（即自身包含价值的形式），那么马克思的货币理论就会过时，更不用说劳动价值论了。

Mainstream economic theory generally acknowledges Marx’s stature as a great thinker, but dismisses outright his monetary theory, or is even unaware of it. There is an unjustified perception of Marx as a ‘metallist’ of little relevance to contemporary monetary phenomena. The prevalence of this view owes much to Schumpeter, whose sweeping assertions about the history of economic thought can befuddle those unfamiliar with the original texts.
It is also due to Marx’s (admittedly copious) references to gold, which have frequently misled Marxist and heterodox economists.
Some Marxist monetary theorists have continued to search for an active role of gold in contemporary monetary phenomena, particularly in relation to the function of money as measure of value.

The presumption is that unless money was shown to retain a commodity form (i.e. a value-containing form), Marx’s monetary theory, not to mention the labour theory of value, would be rendered obsolete.

马克思的货币论著被忽视或遭到片面解读，也与材料本身缺乏条理有关。马克思较为深入的货币研究有很大一部分杂乱地散布在《资本论》第三卷第五篇中。它原是马克思去世后恩格斯在其遗稿中找出的一堆笔记，恩格斯呕心沥血，才将它整理成可以出版的形式。乍看之下，书中混杂着理论要点、经验观察、长篇引文及对他人的评论。要领会其深意，必须耐心研读，尤其要把它放在适当的制度语境中，把握货币思想的发展。评论马克思货币理论的人很少做到这两点。

The dismissal or one-sided reading of Marx’s monetary writings is also due to the material being inherently disorganised. Much of Marx’s advanced monetary work lies in chaotic form in part five of Volume iii of
Capital

. It was actually a jumble of notes that Engels found in Marx’s papers after his death, and brought to publishable form through a true labour of love. At first sight it appears to be a medley of theoretical points, empirical observations, long quotes and comments on others. To appreciate its depth it is necessary to persevere and, above all, to place it in the appropriate institutional context, including the development of monetary thought. These steps are far from common among those who comment on Marx’s theory of money.
不过，即使是马克思本人为出版而撰写的货币理论，也提出了棘手的问题。其核心是对价值与货币的辩证关系所作的高度密集的分析，同时批判性地讨论了众多货币理论家。熟悉马克思方法的人，能从这些论著中获得令人耳目一新的见解。对受过新古典经济学训练的人来说，大量的辩证论证和马克思对经济思想史的系统援引构成了难以逾越的障碍。

Even the monetary theory that Marx actually prepared for publication, however, presents daunting problems. At its core lies very dense analysis of the dialectics of value and money, coupled with critical discussion of an enormous range of monetary theorists. For those familiar with Marx’s method, these monetary writings can offer startling insight. For those trained in neoclassical economics, the prevalence of dialectics as well as Marx’s systematic references to the history of economic thought pose insurmountable challenges.
马克思已发表的货币分析以《资本论》第一卷为基石。《政治经济学批判大纲》也包含相关论述，尽管严格说来，马克思并未将其整理成可出版的稿件，直到他去世很久以后才得以问世。
同样重要的是《政治经济学批判》，这是马克思第一次系统地研究政治经济学，比《资本论》早出版近十年。马克思在这部著作中对货币理论史作了最早的一批梳理之一，由此为自己的货币分析确立了恰当的背景。要理解马克思的货币理论，必须掌握《政治经济学批判》及其中评述的理论家的著作。
The cornerstone of Marx’s published analysis of money can be found in Volume i of
Capital
. Relevant points are also available in the
Grundrisse
, though strictly speaking the latter was not prepared for publication by Marx and appeared long after his death.
Equally important is the
Contribution to the Critique of Political Economy
, Marx’s first systematic foray into political economy, which was published almost a decade before
Capital
. In that work Marx put forth one of the earliest surveys of the history of monetary theory, while placing his monetary analytics in appropriate context. Command over the
Contribution
– and of the work of the theorists surveyed within – is a
sine qua non
for appreciating Marx’s monetary theory.
几十年来，马克思主义理论家反复钻研《资本论》第一卷和《政治经济学批判大纲》（相较之下，对《政治经济学批判》关注少得多），其目的通常是发展劳动价值论。例如，近年来涌现了一批论著，将价值视为必然具有货币表现、即必然表现为货币的抽象劳动。这批文献的源头最终可追溯至20世纪20年代在苏联出版的鲁宾《马克思价值理论文集》。此书深刻影响了当代的价值研究，例如“价值形式”学派。
近来重新兴起的马克思价值理论的货币解读往往带有新黑格尔主义色彩，也深受该书影响。
Marxist theorists have pored over Volume i of
Capital
and the
Grundrisse
(but much less the
Contribution

) for several decades, typically with the aim of developing the labour theory of value. In recent years, for instance, a stream of writings has emerged which treats value as abstract labour that necessarily has a monetary expression, i.e. it necessarily appears as money. The origin of this literature is ultimately Rubin’s
Essays on Marx’s Theory of Value
published in the Soviet Union in the 1920s. This work has had a strong influence on contemporary writings on value, for instance, through the ‘value-form’ current.
It has also been influential in the recent resurgence of monetary interpretations of Marx’s value theory, often with a neo-Hegelian tinge.
对价值与货币关系的关注，是近年来马克思主义经济学家研究货币理论的一个显著特点。
相关成果为马克思主义政治经济学开辟了新的研究空间，但大部分仍以价值为核心，鲜少深入说明作为资本主义经济构成要素的货币现象。
和马克思本人的货币论著相比，这批研究几乎从不与非马克思主义的货币分析对话，也不将马克思主义的分析置于货币理论发展的广阔脉络中。还有一个同样重要的问题：其中许多研究黑格尔式论证过多，挤压了经济学分析。
Concern with the relationship between value and money is a characteristic aspect of the interest in monetary theory among Marxist economists in recent years.

The output produced has created fresh openings for Marxist political economy, but the bulk of it has remained fundamentally about value rather than money. That is, it has rarely offered a specific understanding of monetary phenomena as an integral aspect of the capitalist economy.

In contrast to Marx’s own monetary writings, this work almost never engages with non-Marxist monetary analysis, nor does it place Marxist analysis within the broad evolution of monetary theory. Last but not least, much of it suffers from a surfeit of Hegelian argumentation at the expense of economics.
应从两个方面批判性地评价马克思的货币论著：其内在融贯性，以及它同古典货币理论和其他货币理论的关系。归根结底，马克思主义货币理论的地位，取决于它能否加深我们对当代货币现象的理解。考虑到金融化资本主义显著的货币特征，能否解释现实是首要标准。当然，马克思写作时货币发展的条件迥然不同。但是，只要牢牢把握其思想和历史背景，它们仍能提供有力的指引，下一节将对此加以说明。

Marx’s monetary writings should be critically assessed in terms of both their internal coherence and their relationship to classical and other monetary theory. Ultimately, however, the standing of Marxist monetary theory depends on the insight it offers on contemporary monetary phenomena. Relevance is the prime requirement, particularly in view of the remarkable monetary features of financialised capitalism. Marx’s own writings were, of course, produced under very different conditions of monetary development. But they can still provide powerful guidance, if their intellectual and historical context is kept firmly in mind, as is shown in the following section.

zh: 2.2 马克思主义货币理论与新古典学派、国定论

children: Marxist Theory of Money Relative to Neoclassicism and Chartalism
任何货币理论对实际货币现象的解释力，都部分取决于它如何回答这个问题：货币是什么，又是怎样产生的？乍看之下，这问题似乎微不足道，或深奥难解，仔细考察才会显出它真正的复杂性和重要性。货币能够购买商品，自身却从不被购买；市场参与者普遍持有货币，却不直接消费它；货币通常处于运动中，却也以贮藏的形式静止地保存着，诸如此类。这样一种非同寻常的经济事物为何存在于市场中？它是怎样产生的？

The relevance of any monetary theory to actual monetary phenomena derives in part from the answer it gives to the question: What is money and how does it emerge? At first sight the question appears trivial, or highly abstruse, yet on closer inspection its true complexity and significance begin to emerge. Money has the ability to buy commodities, but is itself never bought; money is universally held by market participants, but is not directly consumed; money’s typical state is to be in motion, but it is also kept static in hoards; and so on, and so forth. Why is such an extraordinary economic entity present in markets, and how does it emerge?
马克思对这个问题给出了独特的回答。只有放在其他货币理论的背景中，才能充分理解这个回答的意义。
值得注意的是，例如古典政治经济学在这个问题上就几乎无所启发。古典经济学家当然关注货币的特殊性，却可以说是从工具性的角度看待这个问题的。亚当·斯密在分析“原始的”商品交换时提出了经典看法。
简而言之，倘若没有货币，直接的商品交换就会盛行。但交易者持有的商品往往在数量、质量、交换时间等方面不相合，直接交换因而容易频频中断。于是，一个“审慎的”交易者必须留存一种人人都想要的商品，以便促成交换。这种商品便是货币。
Marx offered a distinctive answer to this question, the significance of which can be fully appreciated only in the context of other monetary theory.

It is notable, for instance, that Classical Political Economy offers little guidance on this issue. Classical economists were certainly concerned with the peculiarity of money, but approached the issue instrumentally, so to speak. The standard view was put forth by Adam Smith in the course of analysing ‘primitive’ exchange of commodities.

In a nutshell, if money were absent, direct commodity exchange would prevail; however, direct exchange would be prone to constant breakdowns since the commodities held by traders would frequently be incompatible in terms of quantities, quality, time of exchange, and so on. Hence, a ‘prudent’ trader has to keep a commodity desired by all to facilitate exchange. This commodity would be money.
由此可见，斯密清楚地意识到了直接交换本有的经济困难，并将货币同这种困难联系起来。但他没有面对最难的部分：为何会有一种人人都想要的商品？如果这种商品还不是货币，它又如何能够产生？简言之，“货币性”的本质是什么，又是如何形成的？对这个问题的回答直到古典学派衰落后才出现，几乎同时出自新古典学派、德国历史学派和马克思主义。
第一位正面处理此事的大经济学家其实是马克思，不过在经济理论界，他的观点仍是最不为人知的。只有参照其他两个学派，才能充分了解马克思这一回答的解释力。

Smith was thus fully aware of the inherent economic awkwardness of direct exchange, and associated money with it. But he did not confront the most difficult part of the problem, namely why should there be a commodity desired by all? And how could such a commodity emerge, if it were not already money? In short, what is the essence of ‘moneyness’ and how does it come about? Answers to this question began to appear only after the Classical School had gone into decline, and were produced almost simultaneously by Neoclassicism, the German Historical School, and Marxism.

The first major economist to confront the issue was actually Marx, though his views remain the least known within economic theory. However, the power of Marx’s answer can be fully appreciated only in the context of the other two schools.
新古典学派在这个问题上有两种理论取向。占主导地位的一支与瓦尔拉斯的一般均衡理论密切相关，其中货币表现为抽象的价值尺度和交换手段。
尽管看到了货币在商品交换中的根本地位，这种理论却无法在模型中解释货币如何内生地产生。
一般均衡方程自称是资本主义市场最先进的理论表述，最终却把资本主义交易当成了直接交换。

Neoclassicism contains two theoretical strains on this issue. The dominant strain is closely associated with Walras’s formulation of General Equilibrium in which money appears as abstract measure of value and means of exchange.
Despite being aware of the fundamental place of money in commodity exchange, this approach offers no explanation for the endogenous emergence of money in its models.
The equations of General Equilibrium, purporting to be the most advanced theoretical formulation of capitalist markets, ultimately treat capitalist trading as direct exchange.
新古典学派中较小的一支源自门格尔和奥地利学派，在这个问题上提供了更多见解。
门格尔避开对市场运作的数学表述，着眼于个人的选择和行动。把他的论证极度简化，就是：先假定不同商品的“可售性”有所不同；有天分的人识别并求取“可售性”更好的商品，以便完成自己的交易；其他人仿效他们，也求取“可售性”更好的商品。因此，其中一种商品的“可售性”不断提高，直到凌驾于其他一切商品之上，由此成为货币。
The minor neoclassical strain, originating with Menger and the Austrian School, has more to offer on this issue.

Avoiding mathematical formulations of market operations, Menger focused on individual choices and actions. His argument, brutally simplified, is as follows: Commodities are, by assumption, differentially ‘marketable’; gifted individuals identify and demand commodities with better ‘marketability’, thereby facilitating their own transactions; other individuals learn by example and hence also demand commodities with better ‘marketability’; consequently the ‘marketability’ of one commodity increases until it dominates all others, thus becoming money.
门格尔的论证在逻辑上很有力，但其一致性来自对货币作为交换手段的极度专注，对贮藏手段等更复杂的货币职能则少有关注。这大概与门格尔的经济理论方法狭窄有关，他以极端的方法论个人主义为基础。尽管如此，奥地利学派的传统仍给出了新古典理论在货币起源问题上所能提出的最佳论证。近年来，有人尝试把门格尔的论证纳入瓦尔拉斯式的一般均衡框架，增加了大量形式化内容，实质上却没有丰富多少。

Menger’s argument is logically powerful, but its coherence derives from overwhelming focus on money as means of exchange, paying much less attention to more complex functions of money, such as means of hoarding. This was probably related to Menger’s narrow approach to economic theorising, based on extreme methodological individualism. Nonetheless, the Austrian tradition has offered the best argument that Neoclassical theory can muster on the issue of money’s emergence. In recent years, there have been attempts to incorporate Menger’s argument within Walrasian General Equilibrium, adding considerable formalism but not much further substance.
德国历史学派与奥地利学派争论不休，它拒绝门格尔以个人主义建立经济理论的方法，转而借助积累的历史证据，对经济过程作分析性描述。因此，它没有形成货币起源理论。不过，这一学派形成了一套把货币放在更广阔的社会语境中考察的分析，将货币进一步同市场以外、经济以外的力量联系起来。它在经济学之外的社会科学中留下了深远影响，近年来受到的重视也有所增加。

The German Historical School – locked in debate with the Austrians – rejected Menger’s individualist economic theorising, instead favouring analytical descriptions of economic processes that drew on accumulated historical evidence. Consequently, it has produced no theory of money’s emergence. However, it has generated a body of analysis that places money in a wider social context, further associating it with non-market and non-economic forces. Its legacy among social sciences other than economics has been enormous and its prominence has increased in recent years.
大体属于这一思潮而又最有影响力的几种货币观点，出现在德国历史学派走向最终衰落之时。
一种有代表性的看法将货币同共同体内部的非经济力量联系起来，认为货币源于补偿对他人所造成损害的古老习俗，通常称为“赔命金”（Wergeld）。出于显而易见的原因，这一观点在社会科学家中相当有影响力，在经济学家中影响却不大。近年来，博学的钱币学家格里尔森有力地重申了这一观点。
The most influential approaches to money broadly belonging to this current appeared as German Historical School entered its terminal decline.
One prominent view associates money with non-economic forces of a communal character, deriving from ancient practices of recompense for damage inflicted on others, commonly known as
Wergeld

. This approach has had considerable influence among social scientists, though not among economists, for obvious reasons. In recent years, it has been forcefully restated by the erudite numismatist Grierson.
又一种有影响力的观点是国定论（chartalism），它把货币的起源归于国家。最著名的倡导者是克纳普，他认为货币是由国家施行的有关价值的法律约定。
与赔命金路径不同，国定论在经济学中一直占有一席之地。
近年，后凯恩斯主义者重新提出了这一论点：货币本质上是任意设定的建构，依靠法律和习惯上的约定来衡量商品价值。
在金融化资本主义下，国定论有明显吸引力。既然货币领域遍布自身无价值的信用货币，且只能兑换成国家支持的法定清偿手段，人们很容易认为，价值尺度取决于国家的一句话。
A further influential view, known as
chartalism
, identifies the origin of money with the state. The best-known exponent is Knapp, for whom money is a legal convention of value imposed by the state.
Unlike the
Wergeld
approach,
chartalism
has always maintained a toehold in economics.
The argument that money is essentially an arbitrary construct which measures commodity values on the basis of legal and customary conventions has been revived in recent years by Post-Keynesians.

Chartalism has an obvious appeal under conditions of financialised capitalism. Given that the monetary sphere is permeated by valueless credit money convertible only into state-backed legal tender, it is easy to assume that the measure of value results from the say-so of the state.
赔命金论与国定论对于货币起源的解释，范围都比新古典学派的分析更广。二者涵盖货币的若干职能，新古典分析则主要着眼于交换手段。此外，二者都纳入了大量非经济因素来解释货币的产生，因此对人类学家和经济学家特别有吸引力。苏美尔及巴比伦的历史材料表明，货币与信用早已经出现在以君王和祭司的特权为基础的社会中，德国历史学派的方法似乎也与这些证据自然吻合。
从这一点看，货币起源似乎与商品交换无关。
Both the
wergeld
and the
chartalist

approaches to money’s emergence are broader than neoclassical analysis, encompassing several of money’s functions instead of focusing mainly on means of exchange. Moreover, both incorporate a wealth of non-economic factors to account for the emergence of money, and hence have a special appeal for anthropologists and economists. The approach of the German Historical School, furthermore, appears to fit naturally with evidence from Sumerian and Babylonian history regarding the ancient emergence of money and credit in societies that were based on royal and priestly prerogative.
On this score, money’s origin seems unrelated to commodity exchange.
货币同古代中东社会信用实践之间可能存在历史联系，这为提出别种货币起源理论提供了更多机会。在这方面，主流经济理论对探索其他解释的理论家有所助益，尽管经济学界之外的批评者未必承认它的贡献。熊彼特和希克斯都提出过货币的信用理论。
二人的观点虽有差异，却都假定经济主体之间的基本交往属于以支付承诺为基础的信用关系，有别于等价交换中有来有往的做法。按这种观点，货币本质上是一种支付承诺，可以建立在信任、权力、社会习惯等关系之上。主流经济学的批评者认为，将货币理解为支付承诺，似乎扩大了另作分析的空间：货币无须是商品，人们可以在历史上非资本主义社会常有的非商业社会关系中寻找它的起源。

The putative historical connection between money and the credit practices of ancient Middle Eastern societies has offered further possibilities for developing alternative theories of the origin of money. In this connection, mainstream economic theory has been useful to alternative theorists, even if mainstream analysis has not always been acknowledged by critics who are not economists. Thus, both Schumpeter and Hicks have put forth credit theories of money.

Despite differences, both postulate that the fundamental interaction among economic agents is characterised by credit relations based on promises to pay, rather than by the give-and-take characteristic of the exchange of equivalents. From this perspective, money is fundamentally a promise to pay that might be based on relations of trust, power, social custom, and so on. To critics of mainstream economics, treating money as a promise to pay appears to augment the scope for alternative analysis: money does not have to be a commodity and its origin can be sought in non-commercial social relations typically found in non-capitalist historical societies.
德国历史学派衍生出的几种货币理论，有几点值得批评。首先，它们的长处也是它们的弱点之源。这些理论强调非经济力量在货币产生中的作用，从而引导理论家到交换过程之外，甚至到经济领域之外寻找货币的起源。就货币这样一种主要属于经济范畴、并与市场密切相关的现象而言，这种解释远不能令人满意。承认货币具有非经济的面向是一回事，认为它的产生独立于经济过程则是另一回事。

A number of critical points can be made about the approaches to money spawned by the German Historical School. First, it is notable that their strength is also the source of their weakness. Namely, by emphasising the role of non-economic forces in the emergence of money, theorists are led to seek the origins of money outside the process of exchange, and even outside the sphere of the economy altogether. This is deeply unsatisfactory for a phenomenon that is overwhelmingly economic and closely associated with markets. It is one thing to acknowledge that money has non-economic dimensions, but it is quite another to argue that it derives independently of economic processes.
第二，国定论认为货币是由国家任意决定的价值尺度，这个判断本身就是一个任意的断言。国家当然会干预货币的运作，但由此无法推出货币在逻辑上以国家为基础。一个市场之外的权威，若要任意决定商品价值计量的基础，便需要无所不知，而且有非凡的权力。
Second, the
chartalist

view that money is a measure of value determined arbitrarily by the state is itself an arbitrary assertion. The state certainly intervenes in the functioning of money, but that does not mean that money is logically anchored on the state. An extra-market authority would need to possess extraordinary omniscience and power arbitrarily to determine the basis of commodity value measurement.
第三，以信用为基础的货币理论有一个明显弱点：货币的商品形式本身含有价值，无法归为支付承诺。发达资本主义固然以支付承诺构成的货币为基础，但若把黄金等同于支付承诺或债务，就有了逻辑上的跳跃。

Third, credit-based theories of money suffer from the telling weakness that commodity forms of money are not promises to pay since they incorporate value. Advanced capitalism is indeed based on money that comprises promises to pay, but only a leap of logic would equate gold with a promise to pay, or with a debt.
第四，从更宽的范围看，资本主义危机的典型特征是金融关系崩溃、货币关系随之凸显。以信用为基础的货币理论很难为这一现象提供充分的解释。

Fourth, and more broadly, credit-based theories of money offer a slender foundation for explaining the collapse of financial relations and the corresponding rise of monetary relations that is characteristic of capitalist crises.
顺便指出，国定论的某些方面可以追溯到古典政治经济学，这一点颇有启发。亚当·斯密撰写《国富论》前不久，詹姆斯·斯图亚特爵士已提出了一套相当完备的抽象价值计量理论。斯图亚特认为，“记账货币”是一种抽象的计价基准，用以确定观念价格，“物质货币”则在实践中近似实现这些价格。
马克思对斯图亚特的货币分析评价很高，却拒绝接受这个观点。马克思在此问题上的论证，为分析货币如何从商品交换中产生提供了见解。
It is instructive to note, incidentally, that some aspects of the
chartalist
view go back to Classical Political Economy. Sir James Steuart proposed a well-developed version of abstract value measurement shortly before Adam Smith wrote
The Wealth of Nations
. Steuart suggested that ‘money of account’ is an abstract numeraire that establishes ideal prices, which are then approximated in practice by ‘material money’.

Marx, despite the high regard in which he held Steuart’s monetary analysis, rejected this view. Marx’s arguments on this issue offer insight into the analysis of money as originating in commodity exchange.

马克思反对斯图亚特的抽象计价基准理论，核心理由是该理论掩盖了观念价格（货币在纸上或头脑中抽象确立的价格）与实际价格（货币通过经常性的商品交换在实践中确立的价格）的关系。二者的区别是成立的，也确为商品交换的特征，不过实际价格并非观念价格的实际近似值。实际价格反映生产和交换中的地方性、特殊性及偶然因素，因而确实会、也必然会偏离观念价格。偏离并非源于某种观念上的价值尺度与其物质近似值之间的假定差距，而是源于价值的抽象规定是一般的，实际的规定却是特殊的。商品实际交换的运作使抽象的价值成为现实的现象，但这是在具体条件下发生的。此外，使实际价格与观念价格趋于一致的过程，往往伴随剧烈的经济变动，包括货币危机。至于价值尺度本身，完全没有观念性或抽象性可言，因为它是从商品交换的运作中自发产生的。

The gist of Marx’s objection to Steuart’s theory of the abstract numeraire was that it obfuscates the relationship between ideal prices (established abstractly by money on paper, or in the mind) and actual prices (established in practice by money through regular commodity exchanges). The distinction between the two is valid and characteristic of commodity exchange, but actual prices are not practical approximations of ideal prices. Rather, actual prices reflect local, particular and incidental factors of production and exchange; hence they do, and must, diverge from ideal prices. The divergences do not arise from putative disparities between an ideal measure of value and its material approximation, but rather from the universal determination of value in the abstract compared to its particular determination in practice. The actual operations of commodity exchange render the abstraction of value into a real phenomenon, but they do so in specific circumstances. Furthermore the process of reconciling actual and ideal prices often involves violent economic episodes, including monetary crises. The measure of value, however, has nothing ideal and abstract about it, as it arises spontaneously out of the operations of commodity exchange.
马克思对“货币性”的分析早于新古典学派和德国历史学派。他的分析具有深刻的理论性，但并未采取门格尔的个人主义方法；同时涵盖历史学派所关注的多种货币职能及关系。在《资本论》第一卷第一章中可以看到这一分析的成熟形式。马克思在此自豪地宣称，他是第一个解开“耀眼的货币形式”之谜的人。
《政治经济学批判》已通过考察使用价值与交换价值的辩证关系奠定了基础，《政治经济学批判大纲》则探索了货币的历史和社会作用。

Marx’s own analysis of ‘moneyness’ predates those of Neoclassicism and German Historicism. It is profoundly theoretical, though not in the individualist manner of Menger, while incorporating the broad array of money’s functions and relations that concerned the Historical School. Its finished form is found in chapter one of the first volume of
Capital
, where Marx proudly claimed to have been the first to have solved the riddle of the ‘dazzling money-form’.
The
Contribution
had prepared the ground by examining the dialectics of use value and exchange value, while the
Grundrisse
had explored the historical and social role of money.

简而言之，货币是自发成为“一般等价物”或“价值的独立形式”的商品。对马克思而言，由于使用价值与交换价值的矛盾统一，货币必然从商品交换中产生。作为使用价值，商品不能任意分割，只在特定时空可得，而且可能腐坏，凡此种种，都是说它们具有特殊性。作为交换价值，商品的性质恰恰相反，具有一般性。因此，在直接交换中，两个方面不断发生矛盾，导致交换中断。货币的产生是解决（更确切地说是缓和）这些矛盾所必需的。货币作为价值的独立形式，将两个方面拆开，从而解决矛盾：商品就其自身而言是使用价值，作为货币则成为交换价值。简言之，货币交换克服并超越了直接交换。

Summarily put, money is a commodity that emerges spontaneously as the ‘universal equivalent’ or the ‘independent form of value’. For Marx, the emergence of money occurs necessarily in commodity exchange due to the contradictory unity of use value and exchange value. As use values, commodities are imperfectly divisible, available at specific places and times, perishable, and so on, i.e. they are particular. As exchange values, they are the opposite, i.e. general. In direct exchange, therefore, the two sides continually contradict each other, leading to breakdown of exchange. The emergence of money is necessary in order to resolve (or, rather, pacify) the contradictions. Money resolves the contradictions by being the independent form of value, thus disentangling the two sides: commodities can be use values as themselves, while becoming exchange values as money. In short, monetary exchange overcomes and transcends direct exchange.

货币产生的逻辑必然性也有历史和社会维度，马克思在《政治经济学批判大纲》中对此讨论得最为清楚。所有社会都必须在内部交换产品，才能实现自身的再生产。不过，在主要按共同体与联合原则组织生产的社会里，产品未必必须转化为商品。习俗、等级、道德、政治等机制可以促进产品交换，货币因而可以缺席。马克思没有接受亚当·斯密关于“原始”交易的错误抽象。将货币视为商品交换关系的产物，与假定货币源于某种远古的物物交换状态毫无关系。
The logical necessity of money’s emergence also has a historical and social dimension, most clearly discussed by Marx in the
Grundrisse

. To reproduce themselves, all societies must engage in internal exchange of products. However, societies in which production is organised primarily on communal and associational principles need not necessarily turn products into commodities. Customary, hierarchical, moral, political, and other mechanisms could facilitate product exchange, thus excluding money. Marx did not subscribe to Adam Smith’s fallacious abstraction of ‘primitive’ trade. Treating money as the outcome of relations of commodity exchange has nothing to do with assuming that money emerges out of a primordial state of barter.
在马克思看来，由独立的生产资料私有者支配生产的社会，必然把产品转化为商品。这些社会依靠市场组织商品流转以实现再生产，因而需要货币作为社会组织手段，其中又以资本主义社会最为依赖货币。不过，从历史起源看，货币并非产生于共同体的内部组织，也并非为了矫治失灵的物物交换经济而出现。货币产生于共同体彼此接触并发生商品交换的地方。
在共同体彼此接触的时间和地点，“他者性”和“外来性”的关系占主导地位；这就给商品交换留下了余地，使货币得以作为价值的独立代表出现。其后一个多世纪的人类学和社会学研究大体证实了这一见解，显示出它非凡的解释力。

For Marx, societies in which production is run by autonomous and private owners of the means of production necessarily turn products into commodities. Such societies rely on markets to organise the flow of commodities and to allow reproduction to take place: they require money as a social organiser, and none more so than capitalist society. However, the historical origin of money does not lie within the internal organisation of communities; money does not emerge as a curative for a malfunctioning barter economy. Rather, money emerges where communities come into contact with each other and commodity exchange occurs.

When and where communities would come into contact with each other, relations of ‘otherness’ and ‘foreignness’ would be dominant; thus room would be provided for commodity exchange, allowing money to emerge as the independent representative of value. This is an insight of astonishing power in view of anthropological and sociological research that has broadly confirmed its validity during the following century and more.
但在马克思看来，仅说明货币必然在商品交换中产生还不够。真正的理论困难，是要揭示货币自发产生的过程。换言之，要说明“货币性”的本质。马克思在《资本论》第一卷第一章对“价值形式”的分析中给出了回答（确切说，这一分析是马克思在第二版中增补的）。货币由相对价值形式和等价形式的辩证运动产生，这两种形式都内在于商品交换。相对价值形式代表主动因素，即发起交换的一方；等价形式代表被动因素，即作出回应的一方。

For Marx, however, it was not enough simply to show that money must necessarily emerge in commodity exchange. The real theoretical difficulty lies in demonstrating the process through which money emerges spontaneously. Put differently, the problem is to specify the essence of ‘moneyness’. Marx’s answer was given in chapter one of Volume i of
Capital

in analysis of the ‘form of value’ (to be precise, the analysis was added by Marx in the second edition). Money was shown to emerge through the dialectic of the relative and the equivalent forms of value, both of which are inherent to commodity exchange. The relative form stands for the active element, the side which commences the act of exchange; the equivalent form stands for the passive element, the side that responds.

随着相对价值形式与等价形式的辩证运动展开，价值形式经历四个阶段：偶然的价值形式、扩大的价值形式、一般价值形式和货币形式。在每个阶段，相对形式和等价形式都发生转变，直到最后的货币形式阶段，等价形式才牢固地系于某一种商品。这是因为其他所有商品共同处于相对价值形式，从而把被单独区分出来的商品置于一般等价物即货币的位置。由此，货币商品获得了马克思所谓的“形式使用价值”，即能够与其他所有商品直接交换（购买它们）的能力，这便是其“货币性”的基础。

The form of value goes through four stages as the dialectic of relative and equivalent is played out, namely the accidental, the expanded, the general, and the money stage. At each of these stages a transformation occurs of both the relative and the equivalent until, at the final, money stage, the equivalent becomes firmly associated with a single commodity. This happens because all other commodities act collectively as relatives and therefore place the isolated commodity in the position of universal equivalent, i.e. money. Thus, the money commodity acquires what Marx called a ‘formal use value’, namely being able directly to exchange with (buy) all the others, which is the foundation of its ‘moneyness’.
马克思的论证留有若干未尽之处，甚至有缺乏依据的断言，尤其涉及各阶段相互过渡的辩证过程。

不过，他的分析有极强的解释力，理由有几个。首先，它表明货币在商品交换中既是自发产生的，也是必然产生的。其次，它把货币的产生解释为其他商品行动的结果，即一般等价物是处于相对价值形式的商品集体创造的。更关键的是，马克思的分析以“货币性”的“形式”方面为中心。货币性是一种在交换过程中产生的本质属性，离开它就无法对货币的产生作出理论解释。作为商品，各种商品都同样是商品；如果一种商品要从其余商品中分离出来，就必须具备某种额外的维度。在马克思看来，这个维度完全且必然是由其他商品（也就是商品所有者）的行为产生的。换言之，“货币性”并非由国家或某种非经济机构发明，而是由商品之间的相互作用自发产生的社会建构，具有不可化约的经济内涵。
There are loose ends to Marx’s argument – and even unwarranted assertions – particularly regarding the dialectics of the transition among the various stages.

However, his analysis has formidable power for several reasons. For one thing, it shows that money emerges spontaneously as well as necessarily in commodity exchange. Further, it posits the emergence of money as the outcome of the actions of the other commodities, i.e. the universal equivalent is jointly created by the collective relative. Even more crucially, Marx’s analysis pivots on the ‘formal’ aspect of ‘moneyness’. The latter is an essence that arises within the process of exchange without which no theoretical account of money’s emergence would be possible. Commodities are identical
qua

commodities; if one is to stand aside from all the others, it must possess some extra dimension. For Marx, the extra dimension arises solely and necessarily because of the conduct of other commodities (that is, of commodity owners). ‘Moneyness’, in other words, is not invented by the state or some other non-economic agency; it is a social construct emerging spontaneously out of commodity interactions, and therefore containing an irreducible economic content.
概括来说，在马克思看来，货币是一般等价物，或价值的独立形式。在使用价值与交换价值矛盾的推动下，价值形式不断发展，货币遂在商品交换中自发而必然地产生。在从事商品交换的社会，货币具有深刻的历史和社会作用。货币形式往往由一种商品独占，通常是黄金。因而商品货币是货币最初、最基本的形式。

To recap, for Marx, money is the universal equivalent, or the independent form of value. It arises spontaneously and necessarily in commodity exchange as a result of the development of the form of value, and is spurred by the contradictions between use value and exchange value. Money has a profound historical and social role in societies that engage in commodity exchange. The money form tends to be exclusively associated with one commodity, typically gold. Commodity money is thus the original and fundamental form of money.
这些结论为马克思主义货币理论奠定了坚实基础，但它们似乎与当代资本主义中自身无价值的货币占主导地位相矛盾，因而也可能引起疑虑。马克思的货币理论能否阐明金融化在货币上的突出特征，即私人信用货币的兴起、国家支持的中央银行货币的关键地位，以及美元作为准世界货币的出现？只要把货币的职能放到首位，答案就是肯定的。
本章第3、4节循此讨论私人信用货币和国家支持的中央银行货币；第5节接着转向世界货币，为讨论金融化的货币现象奠定基础。

These conclusions are a sound foundation for Marxist monetary theory, but they could also be a source of concern since they ostensibly contradict the prevalence of valueless money in contemporary capitalism. Is Marx’s theory of money capable of casting light on the salient monetary aspects of financialisation, namely the ascendancy of private credit money, the pivotal role of state-backed central bank money, and the emergence of the dollar as quasi-world-money? The answer is in the affirmative, provided the functions of money are brought to the fore.

In this vein, sections 3 and 4 of this chapter discuss private credit money and state-backed central bank money; subsequently, section 5 turns to world money and lays the ground for discussion of the monetary phenomena of financialisation.

zh: 3 当代国内无价值货币：法定货币、私人信用货币与国家支持的中央银行货币
en: 3 Contemporary Valueless Domestic Money: Fiat Money, Private Credit Money and State-Backed Central Bank Money

children: Fiat Money
在马克思主义货币理论看来，货币的原初形式是商品，通常认为是黄金。
不过，货币商品从来只有一种形式的情形并未出现，盐、兽皮、牛、奴隶、烟草和金属等各种商品都曾充当货币。尽管马克思主义的分析揭示了单一货币商品作为价值的独立形式压过其余商品的倾向，这种独一无二的局面在实践中却从未实现。在历史进程中，贵金属的确压过了其他形式的货币商品，但即使在贵金属之中，黄金和白银也一直并行充当货币，直到19世纪下半叶，其中黄金居于首要地位。
For Marxist monetary theory, the original form of money is a commodity, typically taken to be gold.

Yet there has never been a unique form of the money commodity, but rather a range of commodities serving as money, including salt, hides, cattle, slaves, tobacco, metals, and so on. Even though Marxist analysis demonstrates the tendency of a single money commodity to dominate the rest as the independent form of value, in practice such a unique occurrence has never taken place. The precious metals have certainly overshadowed other forms of the money commodity in the course of history; however, even gold and silver functioned concurrently as money until the second half of the nineteenth century, with gold having the paramount role.
不同形式的货币商品并存，是商品交换的自然结果，并不否定趋向单一的一般等价物的倾向。产生一般等价物的经济和社会力量在整个交换领域反复出现，而这些力量反映了具有特定特点的局部条件，因而催生了地方性和局部性的等价物。在任一时点，往往有几种商品争夺一般等价物的位置。
此外，即使一种商品实际上已经超过其他商品，作为一般等价物或价值独立形式的特权，仍一再受到其他商品的挑战。胜负一方面取决于争当货币的商品的物质属性，另一方面取决于使人信任其用途的经济和社会因素，即支撑“货币性”的更广泛的因素。因此，充当一般等价物的商品必须不断重申其相对于其他商品的支配地位。

Multiple and concurrently existing forms of the money commodity are a natural outcome of commodity exchange, and do not negate the tendency toward a single universal equivalent. The reason is that the economic and social forces that lead to the emergence of the universal equivalent are continually replicated across the sphere of exchange. These forces reflect local conditions with specific features, which therefore give rise to local and partial equivalents. At any moment in time, there are likely to be several commodities that strive for the position of the universal equivalent.

Moreover, the privilege of being the universal equivalent, or the independent form of value, is continually contested among commodities, even if one among them would have in practice risen above the rest. Success depends partly on the physical features of the commodity that seeks to be money, and partly on the economic and social factors that generate trust in its use, i.e. on the broader factors that sustain ‘moneyness’. By this token, the commodity that acts as the universal equivalent must continually reassert its dominance over the rest.
法定货币这种形式的产生，主要源于商品货币作为价值尺度和作为交换手段的职能之间的张力。
实际把货币商品用作交换手段，必然造成磨损（欺诈和伪造会加剧磨损问题），价值尺度的职能也因此受到影响：完好无损的（抽象的）货币商品把商品价值表现为一套价格，已减损的（正在流通的）货币商品则把同一价值表现为另一套更高的价格。换言之，商品交换自身的运作产生了一种（已减损的）货币形式，它是其自身的符号。法定货币由此获得了自发产生的空间。
Fiat money represents a form of money arising primarily due to the tension between the function of commodity money as measure of value and its function as means of exchange.

The actual use of the money commodity as means of exchange inevitably results in wear and tear (exacerbated by fraud and counterfeiting); it follows that the function of measure of value would be affected since commodity values would be rendered into one set of prices by the intact (and abstract) money commodity, and into quite another (and higher) set of prices by the degraded (and circulating) money commodity. The intrinsic operations of commodity exchange, in other words, generate a (degraded) form of money that symbolises itself. Thus, room is spontaneously created for fiat money to emerge.
国家将货币商品标准化，可以部分缓和商品货币内部价值尺度和交换手段之间的张力。把商品货币铸成金属铸币，使货币同国家权力联系起来，从而提高其社会接受度。
铸币还在整个交换过程中固定记账单位，从而稳定计量职能，特别是当国家成功限制其他种类和面额的铸币在其境内流通时。
但是，铸币无法消除实际流通中的磨损。它甚至可能使问题恶化，因为国家可能降低铸币的成色，以减轻其债务和其他义务的负担。

The tension between measure of value and means of exchange that is inherent to commodity money could be partly assuaged by the money commodity being standardised by the state. Transforming commodity money into metallic coin strengthens its social acceptability by associating money with the power of the state.

Coin also stabilises the measurement function by fixing the unit of account across the process of exchange, particularly if the state succeeds in limiting other types and denominations of coin within its territory.

But coining does not eliminate the problem of wear and tear through actual circulation. Indeed, coining could make the problem worse since the state could corrupt coin to lessen the burden of its debts and other obligations.
严格意义上的法定货币，以国家发行的自身无价值且不可兑现的符号取代商品货币。法定货币归根结底依赖人们相信国家有能力强制使用它支付。它同商品货币竞争，限制后者在交换领域的使用，同时为价格提供统一的记账单位。法定货币可以有多种形式，从廉价的金属铸币和强制流通的简陋纸币，到由中央银行发行、以国家债务作支撑的复杂法定清偿手段，不一而足。金融化时期占主导地位的法定货币形式与信用货币有所重叠，下文将予说明。

Proper fiat money replaces commodity money with valueless and inconvertible symbols issued by the state. Fiat money ultimately rests on trust in the ability of the state to enforce payments in fiat money; it competes with commodity money and restricts the presence of the latter in the sphere of exchange; it also provides a standard unit of account for prices. Fiat money can take several forms varying from cheap metallic coin, to crude paper monies with forced circulation, to sophisticated legal tender issued by central banks and backed by state debt. The dominant form of fiat money in the period of financialisation overlaps with credit money, as is shown below.
各种形式的法定货币因而有两项基本职能，即充当交换手段和价格的记账单位。能否充分履行这些职能，取决于流通的制度框架，也取决于国家发行法定货币的数量。法定货币若发行过量，显然会把商品价值表现为不断上涨的价格，记账单位的职能就会失灵。若继续超发，作为流通手段的职能也会失灵。因此，通货膨胀和恶性通货膨胀始终威胁着法定货币的有效性。

The various forms of fiat money thus have two fundamental functions, namely means of exchange and unit of account for prices. The adequacy with which they deliver these functions depends on the institutional framework of circulation, but also on the quantities in which fiat money is issued by the state. If fiat money were over-issued, it would obviously render value into rising prices, thus malfunctioning as unit of account; if over-issue persevered, fiat money would also fail as means of circulation. Inflation and hyperinflation are thus constant threats to the validity of fiat money.
不过，原则上某些形式的法定货币完全可以在交换领域无限期地发挥作用。比如，法定铸币省去了把贵金属分割成极小份额的麻烦。其发行成本也低于发行极小面额的信用货币乃至电子货币，本章余下部分将谈到这一点。纵观历史，法定铸币在极为广泛的社会关系和制度中，都很好地适应了小额商品流通。当代铸币对威尼斯市民乃至古罗马平民来说也不会全然陌生。

In principle, however, there is no reason why some forms of fiat money could not function indefinitely in the sphere of exchange. Fiat coin, for instance, obviates the need to cut precious metals in tiny amounts; it is also cheaper than issuing very small denominations of credit money, or even of e-money, as is discussed in the rest of this chapter. Fiat coin has adapted remarkably well to the small end of commodity circulation across a huge range of social relations and institutions in the course of history. Contemporary coin would not have been entirely unfamiliar to Venetian citizens, or even to Roman plebeians.

zh: 3.2 私人信用货币与国家支持的中央银行货币

children: Private Credit Money and State-Backed Central Bank Money
区别于商品货币和法定货币，信用货币由私人发行，源于流通主体之间的信用关系。它本质上是将来支付的承诺，即发行者的负债。通常，金融机构通过发行负债为其发放的贷款筹资，信用货币就在这个过程中创造出来。反过来，贷款到期时，信用货币回到发行者手中（负债随之消除）。
最终结算要么以另一项支付承诺对冲，要么需要商品货币或法定货币介入。

In contrast to commodity and fiat money, credit money is a privately issued form of money that results from credit relations among agents of circulation. It is inherently a promise to pay in the future, i.e. a liability of the issuer. Credit money is normally created as financial institutions issue liabilities to finance the loans they make. By the same token, credit money returns to its issuer as loans mature (liabilities drain away).
Final settlement requires either cancellation against another promise to pay, or the intervention of commodity or fiat money.
信用货币植根于货币作为支付手段的职能，是资本主义经济中信用发展的副产品。
信用货币最初的形式，是对支付一定数量商品货币的承诺，因而产生于信用关系本身。支付承诺之所以能够充当货币，归根结底在于人们相信发行者有能力履行承诺。与法定货币不同，信用货币是资本主义特有的货币形式，因为它是随着资本主义企业的信用需求自发创造的。
Credit money is rooted in money’s function as means of payment and arises as a by-product of the development of credit in capitalist economies.

In its original form it is a promise to pay an amount of commodity money, and thus credit money springs from the very essence of credit relations. A promise to pay is capable of functioning as money ultimately because of trust in the ability of the issuer to fulfil the promise made. Unlike fiat money, credit money is a specifically capitalist form of money insofar as it is created spontaneously and according to the demand for credit among capitalist enterprises.
银行通常向工商企业发放贷款，以扩大自身负债为贷款筹资，信用货币因而支配了大额交易。信用货币在多大程度上取代流通中的其他货币形式，取决于持有者对发行者支付承诺的信任。这种信任又取决于发行者的资产质量及其社会和经济权力。此外，发行者借以发放贷款与创造信用货币的整个信用体系能否保持稳定，也影响着信任。

Typically, banks advance loans to industrial and commercial enterprises, funded through the expansion of bank liabilities, and thus credit money dominates large-scale transactions. The extent to which credit money displaces other forms of money in circulation depends on the holders’ trust in the issuer’s promise to pay. Trust, in turn, derives from the quality of the issuer’s assets, as well as from the issuer’s social and economic power. Furthermore, trust depends on the overall stability of the credit system within which issuers make loans and create credit money.
由此可见，信用货币的具体形式在很大程度上取决于信用体系的组织结构和运作惯例。随着资本主义发展，信用货币也发生了重大变化，从笨拙的可流通商业信用工具，到私人银行券，再到金融机构（主要是银行）发行的不断增加的存款。信用货币在金融化资本主义下继续迅速演变，甚至产生了下文将讨论的电子形式。

It follows that the specific form of credit money depends critically on the institutional structure and the practices of the credit system. Credit money has changed substantially as capitalism has developed, ranging from clumsy circulating trade credit instruments, to private banknotes, to ever-multiplying deposits issued by financial institutions (primarily banks). The evolution of credit money has continued apace under financialised capitalism, even giving rise to electronic forms, discussed below.
国家对信用货币领域的干预，以信用体系自身的自发演变所造成的条件为基础。信用体系的运作往往使一家银行从其余银行中分立出来，成为银行的银行，即中央银行。具体说，银行倾向于将储备集中在一家银行，因而偏好用这家银行的负债结算彼此间的支付承诺。
国家由此获得了宣布银行的银行的负债为法定清偿手段的空间，使债务和其他义务的结算必须接受这些负债。这一举措深刻改变了私人创造的信用货币，使它成为支付中央银行负债的承诺，而非支付货币商品的承诺。

The state intervenes in the realm of credit money on terms that are dictated by the spontaneous evolution of the credit system itself. The operations of the credit system tend to isolate one bank among the others by making it into the bank of banks, i.e. the central bank. Specifically, banks tend to concentrate their reserves in one bank, and consequently to favour its liabilities in settling promises to pay among them.

Room is thus created for the state to declare the liabilities of the bank of banks to be legal tender, making their acceptance obligatory in the settlement of debts and obligations. This action profoundly alters privately created credit money by turning it into a promise to pay the liabilities of the central bank rather than the money commodity.

因此，国家既对信用货币取得主导地位起决定作用，也对排除流通领域中的商品货币起决定作用。不过，分析这个问题需要格外谨慎，以免产生误解。在成熟的资本主义中，信用货币自发地占据大额交易的主导地位，但它从未将商品货币完全排除在流通领域之外，甚至未将其完全排除在个人收入流通之外。银行的银行所发行的负债通常仍是支付货币商品的承诺。无论作为铸币还是作为金银条块，贵金属都有明显优势（自身有价值、易携带、耐久等），因而可以继续在企业之间以及个人收入的流通中充当货币。此处不妨先提一点：贵金属仍然作为世界货币存在，各国也继续为支付和价值转移贮藏商品货币。

The state thus plays a decisive role in the ascendancy of credit money as well as in excluding commodity money from the sphere of circulation. However, considerable analytical care is needed to avoid misconceptions on this point. Credit money comes spontaneously to dominate large-scale transactions in mature capitalism, but it never completely eliminates commodity money from the sphere of circulation, and not even from the circulation of personal income. The liabilities of the bank of banks tend to remain promises to pay the money commodity. The precious metals have obvious advantages as both coin and bullion (intrinsic value, portability, durability, and so on), which allow them to continue serving as money among enterprises and in the circulation of personal income. Tellingly, and running ahead of the following section, the precious metals persist as world money, and states keep hoards of commodity money for payments and value transfers.
只有国家才能最终割断商品货币与资本主义流通之间的联系。典型做法是由国家停止中央银行负债兑换为货币商品。现代史上，英国政府于1914年第一次世界大战爆发时在这方面采取了决定性的措施。
从此，黄金在发达资本主义国家的国内流通中就再未发挥显著的作用。不过，在1944年《布雷顿森林协定》的支持下，黄金在第二次世界大战之后的世界市场上仍占有重要地位。1971—1973年，美国不再履行以35美元兑换1金衡盎司黄金的承诺，信用货币与货币商品的联系才最终切断。黄金已成为最后的贮藏手段，由中央银行和其他国家机构谨慎持有和管理。

The umbilical cord between commodity money and capitalist circulation could only be finally cut by the state. The typical way would be for the state to lift the convertibility of the liabilities of the central bank into the money commodity. In the modern era, the decisive action in this respect was taken by the British state in 1914 at the outbreak of the First World War.

Since that time, gold has not functioned in the domestic circulation of advanced capitalist countries in any significant way. However, gold retained a strong presence in the world market after the Second World War, buttressed by the Bretton Woods Agreement of 1944. The link of credit money with the money commodity was finally severed in 1971–3, when the us reneged on its promise to exchange a troy ounce of gold for $35. Gold has become a hoard of last resort, jealously held and managed by central banks and other state authorities.

切断信用货币与货币商品的联系，对国内和国际流通都产生了深远影响。对国际流通的影响留待后文讨论。在国内流通中，早在两次世界大战之间，废除黄金锚就使国家得以通过一种新颖、独特的国家支持的信用货币管理私人信用货币。具体而言，在当代资本主义下，银行创造的信用货币归根结底是支付中央银行信用货币（银行券和银行准备金）的承诺，国家则宣布后者不能再兑换成任何其他东西。这种发展极大地扩大了经济干预的空间，加之国际上不再以黄金为锚，两者为资本主义金融化奠定了基础。

Severing the link between credit money and the money commodity has had profound implications for both domestic and international circulation. The impact on international circulation is discussed in the next section. In domestic circulation, on the other hand, cutting the gold anchor, already in the interwar years, has made it possible for the state to manage private credit money on the basis of a new and peculiar form of state-backed credit money. To be more specific, in contemporary capitalism bank-created credit money ultimately promises to pay central bank credit money (banknotes and bank reserves), while the state has declared the latter to be inconvertible into anything else. This development has afforded enormous scope for economic intervention and, together with the lifting of the gold anchor internationally, has been fundamental to the financialisation of capitalism.

不能兑现为货币商品、同时具有法偿地位的中央银行货币，是法定货币和信用货币的一种特殊混合体。一方面，即使这些业务涉及中央银行，它仍是随贷款发放而创造、随债务偿还而消退的信用货币。另一方面，它也是法定货币，因为它立足于国家权威，并由中央银行的资产支撑，这些资产通常包括国家债务工具。这样的混合货币有两种具体形式，即中央银行发行的银行券和商业银行存放在中央银行的准备金。两者对金融化都至关重要，但运作方式不同。它们的差异将在下一节详述，此处仅指出以下几点。

Central bank money that is inconvertible into the money commodity, while simultaneously being legal tender, is a peculiar hybrid of fiat and credit money. On the one hand, it is credit money created as loans are advanced and draining away as debt is repaid, even if these operations relate to the central bank. On the other, it is fiat money because it rests on the authority of the state, and is supported by central bank assets that typically include state instruments of debt. Such hybrid money has two specific forms, namely banknotes issued by the central bank and bank reserves held at the central bank; both are fundamental to financialisation but function differently from each other. Their differences are considered in more detail in the following section, suffice it here to note the following.
实际上，企业间的大额交易不使用银行券，工资薪金也很少用银行券支付。它主要在个人收入流通的末端充当交换手段和贮藏手段。
银行券充当货币所需的信任，即它的社会接受度，来自国家的支持和日常使用中的惯例。发达国家间银行券使用情况差别很大，既取决于银行业的制度机制，也取决于个人收入支出的习俗和习惯。中央银行被动地供应银行券，因为它们认为银行券与信用货币管理及更一般的信用流量管理基本无关。

Banknotes are in practice absent from large-scale transactions among enterprises and are rarely used to pay wages and salaries. They function primarily as means of exchange and hoarding at the tail end of individual income circulation.

The trust required for banknotes to function as money (i.e. their social acceptability) is generated through the backing of the state as well as through the norm of daily use. Banknote use differs significantly among advanced countries, depending on the institutional mechanisms of banking but also on the customs and habits of personal income expenditure. Central banks supply banknotes passively since they consider banknotes to be largely irrelevant to the management of credit money and of credit flows more generally.

银行准备金则是大型金融机构之间的主要贮藏手段和支付手段，也是私人创造的信用货币的最终兑付手段。因此，准备金是国家管理国内货币及影响信用流量的重要手段。准备金的使用首先取决于私人银行对中央银行的信任，其次取决于持有准备金的成本。对中央银行的信任又取决于国家支持和中央银行的资产质量。中央银行与私人银行在制度规则和惯例方面展开复杂而持续的博弈，以确保银行准备金始终是金融机构及其他机构之间结算私人创造的信用货币的首选形式。这势必使发达资本主义国家实际使用准备金存款的方式有所不同，下一节将予讨论。

Bank reserves, on the other hand, are the primary means of hoarding and payment among large financial institutions; they also provide the ultimate means of redemption for privately created credit money. Thus, bank reserves are a vital lever used by the state to manage domestic money but also to influence credit flows. The deployment of bank reserves depends on, first, the trust that private banks have in the central bank and, second, on the cost of holding reserves. Trust in the central bank, in turn, depends on state backing, but also on the quality of the assets of the central bank. A complex game of institutional rules and practices is continually played between the central bank and private banks to ensure that bank reserves remain the preferred form of settlement for privately created credit money among financial and other institutions. This inevitably results in differences in the use of reserve deposits among developed capitalist countries in practice, discussed in the following section.

zh: 4 金融化过程中的国内无价值货币：电子货币
en: 4 Domestic Valueless Money in the Course of Financialisation: Electronic Money

children: 上述讨论表明，自身无价值的货币对马克思主义货币理论并不构成难题，妨碍分析的那种“金属主义”并不存在于马克思的理论中。无价值货币必然且自发地产生，采取法定货币和信用货币两种形式。作为前者，它是商品货币的符号性替代物；作为后者，它是支付商品货币或支付由国家支持、本身不含价值的货币单位的承诺。两种货币形式都依照支撑其产生的经济与制度关系，进入资本主义流通。

It is apparent from the preceding discussion that valueless money poses no problems for Marxist monetary theory – there is no crippling ‘metallism’ in Marx. Valueless money arises necessarily and spontaneously and takes the form of both fiat and credit money. As the former, it is a symbolic replacement of commodity money; as the latter, it is a promise to pay commodity money, or a state-backed unit of money that is itself valueless. Both forms intervene in capitalist circulation according to the economic and institutional relations that support their emergence.

在金融化过程中，私人信用货币和国家支持的中央银行货币继续演变，尤其表现为采用电子形式。此外，还出现了质上有别于信用货币的电子货币形式，在资本主义流通中，这是颇不寻常的现象。对这些发展作更细致的经验考察，可以进一步阐明金融化资本主义的基本关系。下文涉及美国、日本、德国和英国，也就是本书在经验分析中广泛考察的四个国家。数据来自国际清算银行（BIS），覆盖20世纪90年代和2000年代，其间金融化达到高峰。

In the course of financialisation, both private credit money and state-backed central bank money have continued to evolve, particularly by adopting electronic forms. Furthermore, forms of electronic money have emerged that are qualitatively different from credit money, a rather unusual phenomenon in capitalist circulation. Closer empirical examination of these developments could cast further light on the underlying relations of financialised capitalism. The discussion below relates to usa, Japan, Germany and the uk, the four countries that are more broadly considered throughout this book in empirical terms. Data comes from the Bank of International Settlements (bis) and refers to the 1990s and 2000s, the decades during which financialisation reached a peak.

zh: 4.1 私人信用货币采取电子形式

children: Private Credit Money Takes Electronic Form
分析可从简要描述近年来货币交易所采取的形式入手。国际清算银行将交易分为“现金交易”（即以银行券和铸币完成的交易）和“非现金交易”（即通过信用卡或借记卡、直接借记、支票及贷记转账完成的交易）。按前面的分析，前者使用法定货币或国家支持的中央银行货币，后者使用信用货币。

It is instructive to start the analysis by briefly describing the form taken by monetary transactions in recent years. The bis classifies transactions as ‘cash’ (i.e. completed with banknotes and coin) and ‘cashless’ (i.e. completed with credit or debit cards, direct debits, cheques, and credit transfers). In terms of the preceding analysis, the former are transactions using fiat or state-backed central bank money, while the latter are credit money transactions.
在信用货币交易中，支票与直接借记或贷记转账几乎没有实质差别。支票是用于在银行账户之间划转贷方余额的书面付款指令，直接借记或贷记转账是通常采取电子形式的类似付款指令。区别在于，支票主要通过纸质形式变更账上货币记录，转账则通过电子形式作同样的变更。
借记卡是在银行账户间转移已有资金的另一种方式。相对而言，信用卡通常为持卡人提供信用，即发卡方提供的贷款。不过，借记卡也可能允许对已有银行账户透支，因而模糊了已经持有一笔货币与从贷款人处取得新资金之间的区别。两种卡都在交易双方之间以电子方式转移账上的货币记录。

Among credit money transactions, there is little substantially to differentiate cheques from direct debits or credit transfers. Cheques are written payment orders transferring credits among bank accounts, while direct debits or credit transfers are similar payment orders that typically take an electronic form. The difference is that cheques alter money entries mostly in paper form, while transfers do the same electronically.

Debit cards are yet another way of transferring funds already existing in bank accounts. Credit cards, on the other hand, typically provide the holder with credit, that is, with a loan made by the card supplier. However, debit cards could also allow for overdrafts on existing bank accounts, blurring the difference between already possessing a sum of money and obtaining fresh funds from a lender. Both types of card move money entries electronically among transacting parties.
由此可考察20世纪90年代中期到2000年代中期非现金交易的变化。图12.1、12.2、12.3和12.4分别显示信用卡或借记卡、支票、贷记转账及直接借记占非现金交易总笔数的比例。

这段时期内，四国占主导地位的信用货币形式差异很大。日本的用卡比例一直高于其余各国，德国显著低于其他国家。支票在德国和日本的份额一直不大，在美国则得到大量使用。除这些反映制度、法律甚至文化差异的不同之外，值得注意的是，样本各国卡支付都有所增加，支票使用则一直在减少。即使在传统上很大一部分交易依靠支票的美国，支票的衰落也很明显。

There has been considerable variation in the dominant forms of credit money across the four countries during this period. Japan has consistently used cards more heavily than the rest, while Germany has lagged significantly behind the others; cheques have never had much weight either in Germany or Japan, while they have been strongly used in the usa. Apart from these variations that reflect institutional, legal and even cultural differences, it is notable that the use of cards has risen across the sample, while cheques have been in retreat. The decline of cheques is clear even present in the usa, which has traditionally relied on cheques for a large part of the total number of transactions.

综合交易总笔数与总金额推断，这一时期大规模交易中的货币主要通过贷记转账、直接借记和支票流通。可以合理推断，这些主要是企业之间的交易，而借记卡和信用卡主要用于个人收入流通。证据还显示，与通过纸质指令变更银行账户记录相比，人们越来越多地采用电子形式。

Extrapolating from both total number and total value of transactions, it appears that credit transfers, direct debits, and cheques have been the money of large-scale transactions during this period. It is reasonable to suppose that these have been transactions among enterprises, while debit and credit cards have been used primarily to circulate private income. The evidence also shows that electronic forms of transferring bank account entries have been increasingly used compared to paper-based forms.
金融化时期日益占据主导地位的电子形式的信用货币，可称为“接入型电子货币”。这是一个总称，涵盖以电子方式转移传统信用货币的各种手段。典型例子包括借记卡和信用卡，还有贷记转账和直接借记等日益“电子化”的支付形式。
接入型电子货币并未造成理论上的难题，因为它基本上只是将信用货币的物质形式从纸张变为电子信号。早在两次世界大战之间，国际商业银行已在清算过程中采用电子方式传输货币。不过，金融化似乎以接入型电子货币的使用加深为特征，无论在公司之间还是个人收入流通中都是如此。

The electronic form of credit money that has been on the ascendant in the years of financialisation can be called ‘access electronic money’, or ‘access e-money’. This is an envelope term that captures several means of transferring conventional credit money electronically. Typical examples are debit and credit cards but also other forms of payment that have been increasingly ‘electronified’, such as credit transfers, and direct debits.

Access e-money presents no theoretical challenges since it involves little more than altering the corporeal form of credit money from paper to electronic signals. International commercial banks have been using electronic forms of money transmission in the clearing process since the interwar years. It appears, however, that financialisation has been marked by stronger use of access e-money both among corporations and in the circulation of personal income.
接入型电子货币的普及与金融化过程中银行的转型有关。新的信息和电信技术既推动了银行放贷方式的变化，也使电子交易的完成成本低于分拣和处理纸质指令的成本。另一方面，引进电子交易处理能力，包括布设自动柜员机（ATM），也给银行带来大量投资成本，包括组织和所需劳动技能方面的变革。
因此，金融化过程中接入型电子货币的普及，既反映了新技术的采用，也反映了银行内部组织乃至分支机构结构的变化。

The spread of access e-money is related to the transformation of banks in the course of financialisation. The introduction of new information and telecommunications technology which has contributed to changes in the lending practices of banks has also lowered the costs of completing transactions electronically compared to sorting and processing paper orders. On the other hand, introducing electronic transaction processing capacity, including Automated Teller Machines (atms) has imposed substantial investment costs on banks, including changes in organisation and requisite labour skills.
The spread of access e-money in the course of financialisation, thus, reflects the introduction of new technology but also the altered internal organisation and even the branch structure of banks.

在这一时期，接入型电子货币很可能对总体盈利能力产生了显著影响，不过幅度难以估量。对银行来说，它使“实时”交易结算更便宜、更便捷。可以推测，它也可能缩短了产业资本和商业资本的周转时间，从而提高盈利能力。在其他条件相同的情况下，企业还可以持有较少的货币储备，盈利能力因而进一步提高。更一般地说，接入型电子货币的普及可能加快了金融机构的运作，从而推动金融化。不过，接入型电子货币在非现金交易中地位的上升，并没有导致现金交易减少。图12.9显示了银行券与铸币的使用情况。

Access e-money has probably had a significant effect on aggregate profitability during this period, though it is hard to assess its magnitude. For banks, it has facilitated cheaper and easier settlement of transactions in ‘real time’. By implication it has probably speeded up the turnover time of industrial and commercial capital, thus boosting profitability. Other things being equal, enterprises would also have kept lower money reserves, hence also boosting profitability. More generally, the spread of access e-money has probably accelerated the operations of financial institutions, thus encouraging financialisation. Nonetheless, the ascendancy of access e-money within cashless transactions has not induced a decline in cash transactions, as is shown in Figure 9 depicting the use of banknotes and coin:
同样，四国间存在反映历史、制度和文化因素的显著差异。日本和德国通常比美国和英国更多使用现金，不过德国马克由欧元取代，影响了德国数据。图12.9中最引人注目的是，在整个时期内，所有国家都持续使用现金。在日本，现金使用实际上大幅增加，不过这可能与20世纪90年代和2000年代长期的金融不稳定，以及中央银行为此采取的量化宽松政策有关，第4.3节将进一步讨论。

Again, there has been significant variation across the four countries reflecting historical, institutional and cultural factors. Japan and Germany have been generally heavier users of cash than the usa and the uk, though the figures for Germany have suffered because of the replacement of the Deutschmark by the euro. The striking feature of Figure 9, however, is the persistence of cash across all countries throughout this period. In Japan, the use of cash has actually increased substantially, though this has probably been related to the long period of financial instability in the 1990s and 2000s and the associated policy of Quantitative Easing by the central bank, which is further discussed in Section 4.3.
为什么接入型电子货币的普及未能减少银行券和铸币的使用？这个问题也受到主流经济学家的关注，他们普遍预期现金使用会下降。
看似矛盾的是，现金的持续使用部分是接入型电子货币普及带来的意外结果。银行广泛布设自动柜员机，为使用借记卡和信用卡提供便利，也使人们能更方便、更频繁地提取小额现金。因此，恰当的问题是：为何流通中对银行券和铸币的需求仍很旺盛？以下三个因素很重要，也有助于阐明货币在金融化资本主义中的作用。

Why has the spread of access e-money failed to lead to a decline in the use of banknotes and coin? This issue has also concerned mainstream economists, who have generally expected the use of cash to fall.

Paradoxically, the persistence of cash is in part an unintended consequence of the spread of access e-money. For, as banks have developed extensive atm networks facilitating the use of debit and credit cards, cash has also become more readily available in small sums that could be obtained more frequently. The question then properly becomes, why did the demand for banknotes and coin in circulation remain strong? The following three factors are important, and shed light on the role of money in financialised capitalism.
